instruction: ARTBOOK FIRST remains the production gate. Company-wide final artbook submission is capped at one combined artbook per day. For the selected game of the day, planning owns story/world/causality, graphics owns character/monster/boss/environment/UI/intro concepts, development owns implementation structure and playable-demo architecture, QA owns player-flow/problem-scene/test evidence, and balance owns progression/combat feel/reward/difficulty. Departments collaborate and exchange evidence but do not author each other's sections. The director/ChatGPT may only assemble and summarize the five submitted sections into the single daily artbook and may not invent missing content. The director is also the company's active staff supervisor: for every department it must verify actual task assignment, workflow/execution evidence, result evidence, verification, blockers and next action. A running label without execution evidence is not work and must be classified as FALSE_RUNNING or STALE. When assigned work is not progressing, the director must identify whether the cause is a missing work order, missing or untriggered automation, workflow failure, missing output, validation failure, dependency/permission problem, or evidence-adapter mismatch, then fix low-risk operational blockers or escalate core decisions. Each game must receive one initial combined artbook containing all five department sections before formal production progression. Existing Web games and daechung-rpg code/builds are prototype evidence. Homepage exposure is not itself a production-approval gate: daechung-rpg may keep direct development-artbook exposure while other games/artbooks may appear automatically in compact pre-production UI or dedicated detail pages so the homepage does not become excessively long. Homepage visibility must never be treated as formal production PASS. Artbooks remain game-specific and follow artbook-style-profiles.json; uniform templates are forbidden. Story causality is the highest quality gate. Unity Android test builds use local-first hybrid routing: when the jaewoon-unity self-hosted PC runner has a recent verified heartbeat, build locally with the installed activated Unity; when it is offline or has no fresh heartbeat, use the GitHub-hosted cloud fallback. A cloud Unity Personal path must use a Unity-supported activation mechanism and must not rely on a ULF-to-UNITY_SERIAL conversion after that path has produced Unity error 20110. The current named-user empty-serial cloud activation path is experimental until an actual APK build verifies it; if it fails, cloud Personal is blocked and the local licensed runner remains the valid route. After any material implementation, build, CI, licensing, gameplay, graphics, QA, or balance modification, previous department votes must not be carried forward as the post-change verdict. Once current verification evidence exists, planning, development, QA, graphics, and balance must independently reevaluate the modified state, then the director must aggregate only those five submitted reviews and cast a new PASS/REVISE/DROP verdict. The director/ChatGPT may not invent a missing department vote. Never modify web-games source files and never use paid automation or paid runners.
